ui.people.col.name: Name
ui.people.notFound: This person is not in the list.
ui.people.inviteHint: The link to set a password is valid for 7 days.
ui.people.suspendNote: {name} will be signed out on every device and cannot sign in until reactivated. The account stays, and the name stays on records, approvals and the audit log.
ui.people.suspendedNote: Suspended. They cannot sign in until reactivated.
ui.admin.intro: Running the organisation. Changes here take effect straight away.
ui.admin.homeIntro: Running the organisation. Changes here take effect straight away.
ui.admin.settings.name: Display name
ui.admin.settings.languageHint: For new people and messages; each person can choose their own in More
ui.admin.settings.apiRate: API requests per minute, per key
ui.admin.settings.cors: Sites that may read data feeds
ui.admin.settings.corsHint: One exact address per line, such as https://example.org. At most 10. Leave this empty and only a server with the key can call.
ui.admin.settings.corsInvalid: Each line is an http or https address with no path, and there are at most 10.
ui.admin.settings.signInIntro: Password sign-in, email codes and single sign-on are set by the platform operator. Ask them to change these.
ui.admin.settings.signInProviders: Single sign-on offered on your sign-in page:
ui.admin.settings.signInNone: No single sign-on is offered. People sign in with a password or an email code.
ui.admin.settings.fyStartHint: Sets when the books, receipt numbers and record numbers start a new year. It is fixed once a year is opened or a receipt issued.
ui.admin.settings.fyStartFixed: Fixed: a financial year has been opened or a receipt issued, so closed years and receipt numbers stay as they are.
ui.admin.settings.mailIntro: Choose the connector that sends this organisation's email. Leave it empty and no email is sent.
ui.admin.settings.mailFromHint: The address messages are sent from.
ui.admin.settings.emailsIntro: The emails for sign-in codes, password resets and invitations. Choose one of this organisation's published message templates for each, or keep the default wording.
ui.admin.settings.fileStoreHint: New uploads, exports and the logo go to this storage connector.
ui.admin.organisation.otherSettings: Language, storage, API and financial year
ui.admin.organisation.confirmReceipts: I have reviewed the receipt series
ui.admin.organisation.setup.identityHint: Legal name, contact email and address filled in, then confirmed
ui.admin.organisation.setup.registration: At least one registration, such as 12A or 80G
ui.admin.organisation.setup.fiscalYearHi: The current financial year is open
ui.admin.organisation.setup.receiptSerie: The receipt numbering has been reviewed
ui.admin.organisation.setup.operationalR: Someone besides the administrator holds a working role, such as Finance
ui.admin.organisation.setup.emailHint.or: Sent through the organisation's own email connector
ui.admin.organisation.setup.emailHint.no: No email is sent until an email connector is set up
ui.admin.organisation.setup.fileStoreHin: A storage connector is chosen in Settings
ui.admin.organisation.setup.paymentsHint: A payment connector is set up
ui.admin.organisation.legalNameHint: As it appears on the registration documents; printed on receipts
ui.admin.organisation.identityIntro: The name people see, the legal name on receipts, and the language used until someone chooses their own.
ui.admin.organisation.profileIntro: How to reach the organisation. The logo and names are on Identity.
ui.admin.organisation.registrationsIntro: Certificates such as 12A and 80G. Each one is kept on its own.
ui.admin.organisation.previewHint: App bar, sign-in and new receipts
ui.admin.settings.intro: These apply to the whole organisation. Each one is stored as its own setting.
ui.admin.organisation.countryHint: Use the two-letter country code, e.g. IN.
ui.admin.organisation.countryInvalid: That is not a two-letter country code. India is IN.
ui.admin.organisation.regTypeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - or _, e.g. 80g, 12a, fcra
ui.admin.organisation.expiryBeforeIssue: The expiry date cannot be before the issue date.
ui.admin.organisation.logoHelp: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 1 MB. Shown in the app, on the sign-in page and on new receipts.
ui.admin.organisation.logoType: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
ui.admin.organisation.logoSize: The logo must be at most 1 MB.
ui.admin.organisation.signatoryHelp: A receipt rule or report prints the signatories chosen for it in its builder. A document already issued keeps the signatories it was issued with.
ui.admin.organisation.signatureHelp: A PNG image of at most 200 kB.
ui.admin.organisation.signatureType: The signature must be a PNG image.
ui.admin.organisation.signatureSize: The signature must be at most 200 kB.
ui.admin.organisation.signatoryNameRequi: Enter a name of at most 120 characters.
ui.admin.organisation.signatoryDesignati: Enter a designation of at most 120 characters.

ui.admin.hint.migration: Bring in CSV files from another system
ui.admin.hint.settings: Financial year, storage and API limits
ui.admin.signatories.intro: The people who sign documents, with their signature images. Each report and receipt rule chooses who signs it in its builder.
ui.admin.hint.layout: Link order, icons, and how lists open
ui.admin.theme.published: Theme published. Everyone sees it on the next screen load.
ui.admin.theme.confirmTitle: Some text is hard to read
ui.admin.theme.confirmBody: A colour pair is below the usual contrast. You can choose another colour, or publish this theme anyway.
ui.admin.theme.contrast.banner: {pair} is below AA for body text.
ui.admin.layout.phoneNote: Drag a card by its handle to change its place. This order is what every screen follows. A phone shows the first three and More when there are more than four links. A wider screen shows every link that fits.
ui.admin.layout.listHint: Phones always use cards. A person's own choice, kept in the address, wins over this.
ui.admin.layout.published: Layout published. Everyone sees it on the next screen load.
ui.admin.roleRulesHint: Roles, permissions and the access map
ui.admin.roles.setInBuilder: Permissions are set in the Builder.
ui.admin.roles.intro: Who holds each role, and what it allows.
ui.admin.roles.membersIntro.one: {count} member. Changes take effect straight away.
ui.admin.roles.membersIntro.other: {count} members. Changes take effect straight away.
ui.admin.roles.permissionsIntro: What this role allows. Saving updates it straight away.
ui.admin.roles.pickHint: Active and invited people; choose several.
ui.admin.roles.twoStepNote: {role} requires two-step sign-in. People who have not set it up are asked to when they next sign in.
ui.admin.connectors.note: Nothing is sent through a connector until it is set up and switched on.
ui.admin.connectors.archivedNote: This connector is archived: switched off, left out of every choice and kept with its delivery log. Restore it to change it.
ui.admin.connectors.archiveHelp: Switch off to pause sending. Archive to retire a connector and tidy the list; nothing is deleted.
ui.admin.connectors.archiveNote: It is switched off and left out of every choice. Its settings and delivery log are kept, and you can restore it later. It cannot be archived while a definition, Settings or another connector still uses it.
ui.admin.connectors.restoredDone: Connector restored. It stays switched off until you switch it on.
ui.admin.bin.note: Deleted records are kept here. Restoring one puts it back as it was, with its number and history.
ui.admin.bin.restoreNote: It comes back as it was. A record that refers to something still deleted, or whose unique value has been taken since, cannot be restored until that is put right.
ui.admin.connectors.h.placeholders: Placeholders in double braces: record.<field>, message.to, message.subject, message.text, message.title, organisation.name, secrets.<name>, credential.accessToken.
ui.admin.connectors.h.emailPlaceholders: Placeholders in double braces: message.to, message.subject, message.text, message.from, message.mime (with | base64url for Gmail-style APIs), organisation.name, secrets.<name>, credential.accessToken.
ui.admin.connectors.h.gmailCredential: An oauth connector whose scopes include https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send.
ui.admin.connectors.h.gmailUserId: Usually me. The signed-in Google account must be allowed to send as the From address in Settings.
ui.admin.connectors.h.headers: An object of header names and their values.
ui.admin.connectors.h.inputs: Record fields the address and body may use.
ui.admin.connectors.h.responseMap: An object naming each value the lookup returns, with its path in the answer, such as data.name.
ui.admin.connectors.h.success: A list of the HTTP statuses that count as success, such as [200, 201]. Any 2xx answer when empty.
ui.admin.connectors.h.scopes: Each permission to ask the provider for.
ui.admin.connectors.h.prefix: Optional folder inside the bucket. Every file is still kept under the organisation.
ui.admin.connectors.h.endpoint: Optional https address of an S3-compatible store.
ui.admin.connectors.h.folderId: The Drive folder these files are kept in.
ui.admin.connectors.h.secrets: Name a secret the address, headers or body use as secrets.<name>, then type its value and save.
ui.admin.connectors.secretName: Use letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
ui.admin.connectors.connectedUntil: Connected. The access token is valid until {time}.
ui.admin.connectors.connectAfterSave: Save the connector, then connect it.
ui.admin.connectors.connectError.denied: The provider was not given access. Connect again to allow it.
ui.admin.connectors.connectError.failed: Connecting failed. Check the settings and connect again.
ui.admin.connectors.redirect: Redirect address to register with the provider
ui.admin.keys.col.name: Name
ui.admin.keys.subject: This key
ui.admin.keys.feedHint: The key can read only this published feed
ui.admin.keys.nameHint: Records it changes show this name after api:
ui.admin.keys.roleHint: The key can do exactly what this role allows
ui.admin.keys.copyNow: Copy this secret now. It is shown only once.
ui.admin.keys.revokeNote: Systems using this key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
ui.admin.migration.intro: Bring in the tables of another system as CSV files. Any file is accepted, with its own columns; you choose which record types each one fills.
ui.admin.migration.denied: You do not have access to data migration. Ask an administrator who can migrate data.
ui.admin.migration.name: Name
ui.admin.migration.empty: No migration yet. Name one, then add the CSV files you exported.
ui.admin.migration.isRunning: This migration is running. Files, mappings and books cannot change until it ends.
ui.admin.migration.filesIntro: Add every table you exported. Each file keeps its own header row and columns. Up to 10 MB and 20,000 rows a file.
ui.admin.migration.mapIntro: Choose the record types this file fills. One row can fill several, for example a supporter and their donation. Columns you leave out are not imported.
ui.admin.migration.noTypes: There is no record type to fill yet. Add one in the Builder first.
ui.admin.migration.oldIdHint: A later file points at this record by this value, and a second run updates the record instead of adding another.
ui.admin.migration.required: Every row must make this record
ui.admin.migration.requiredHint: When off, a row whose old id for this record is empty, or whose cells for it are wrong, still loads its other records.
ui.admin.migration.orderIntro: Files load from top to bottom. A file that looks up records by old id waits for the files that write them.
ui.admin.migration.leftOut: Not mapped; left out of the run
ui.admin.migration.booksIntro: Opening balances and the next receipt number apply once, after every file has loaded. Old transfers are not replayed as journals.
ui.admin.migration.booksNoPermission: You cannot set the books of a migration.
ui.admin.migration.checkIntro: Nothing is saved. Every row of every mapped file goes through the same checks as a save, in load order.
ui.admin.migration.sourceCheck: {ready} ready · {invalid} with problems · {creates} to create · {updates} to update
ui.admin.migration.runIntro: You can leave this page. Automations, mail and receipts stay off for the run.
ui.admin.migration.cancelRequested: The run stops after the current batch.
ui.admin.migration.stopped: The run stopped. Rows already loaded stay; check and run again to load the rest.
ui.admin.migration.notRun: Not run yet. Check the files, then run.
ui.admin.migration.warnings: Warnings (these do not stop the run)
ui.admin.migration.kindRecordsHint: Fill record types such as donors or donations.
ui.admin.migration.kindPeopleHint: Add people to this organisation, with roles. No passwords and no emails.
ui.admin.migration.kindPeopleDenied: Needs Migrate people and Manage people. Ask an organisation administrator.
ui.admin.migration.kindPeopleNote: People need two permissions: Migrate people and Manage people. They are added as Invited.
ui.admin.migration.kindNoPeople: You cannot add people. You can still map record files. A profile with a people file can only be mapped and run by someone with both permissions.
ui.admin.migration.people.oldIdHint: Any format. Used to link records to people.
ui.admin.migration.people.emailHint: The sign-in address. No email is sent.
ui.admin.migration.people.name: Name
ui.admin.migration.people.nameHint: Shown as the person’s display name.
ui.admin.migration.people.statusColumnHi: Optional. Without it everyone is added as active.
ui.admin.migration.people.rolesColumnHin: Several roles in one cell, separated by the separator below.
ui.admin.migration.peopleValuesHint: Separate values with commas, for example 1, yes. Case is ignored.
ui.admin.migration.rolesUnavailable: The list of roles could not be read, so roles cannot be chosen. Ask someone who manages roles, or leave the roles column out.
ui.admin.migration.roleTwoStep: {role} requires two-step sign-in. People with it could not sign in. Choose Ignore and add the role after they have signed in and enrolled.
ui.admin.migration.roleNone: No role values were found in the first rows. Add the legacy roles below.
ui.admin.migration.roleValuesNote: Only the first values found in the file are listed. Add any other legacy role below. People who already belong keep their roles; nothing is removed.
ui.admin.migration.peopleReady: Roles are limited to the ones you may give. People who already belong keep their roles; nothing is removed.
ui.admin.migration.personLegacyHint: Looks the person up from the people file. A blank cell stays blank.
ui.admin.migration.personOnMissing: If the person is not found
ui.admin.migration.warningGroup.duplicat: Emails shared by several legacy ids
ui.admin.migration.checkPeople: {rows} rows · {ready} ready · {invalid} invalid · {creates} to add · {updates} already here
ui.admin.migration.checkRecords: {rows} rows · {ready} ready · {invalid} invalid · {creates} to create · {updates} to update
ui.admin.migration.attach.title: Attachments
ui.admin.migration.attach.intro: Photos, scans and documents that your records point at by file name. Each file can be used by one row.
ui.admin.migration.attach.dropTitle: Drop a folder or files here
ui.admin.migration.attach.dropHint: A folder keeps its folder names, such as scans/D-1042.pdf, so the names in your CSV must match.
ui.admin.migration.attach.limits: Up to {limit} files. Each file must be within the size limit of its field, or 25 MB. Files count against your organisation's storage.
ui.admin.migration.attach.clearBody: This removes {count} attachments from this migration. Records that already hold a file keep it. You can upload the files again.
ui.admin.migration.attach.pathLong: The path is longer than 255 characters.
ui.admin.migration.attach.tooMany: A migration holds at most {limit} attachments.
ui.admin.migration.attach.deleted: The source files and attachments were deleted. Add the files again to check or run this migration.
ui.admin.migration.file.columnHint: Names must match files on the Files step, such as scans/D-1042.pdf. A blank cell leaves the field empty.
ui.admin.migration.purge.title: Delete source files and failed-row data?
ui.admin.migration.purge.hint: Removes the uploaded CSV files, the attachments, the sample values and the text of failed rows. Records, people and books already loaded stay.
ui.admin.migration.purge.button: Delete source files and failed-row data
ui.admin.migration.purge.body: This deletes the uploaded CSV files, every attachment, the sample values and the stored text of failed rows. Records, people and books already loaded are not touched. Failed-row downloads stop working, and this migration cannot be checked or run again until you add the files again.
ui.admin.migration.purgedOn: Source files and failed-row data deleted on {date}.
ui.admin.migration.purgedHint: To fix failed rows and run again, add the corrected files on the Files step and check again. People and records already loaded are matched by their legacy ids.
